P5-GAP-001.current_ui_behavior: Operator enters mobile phone number on owner registration form as a mandatory field, but backend register endpoint drops it entirely without saving.
P5-GAP-001.actual_business_semantics: Owner phone is essential for SMS notifications, password recovery, and tenant verification.
P5-GAP-001.ux_problem: Operator is given false confidence that their phone number is registered.
P5-GAP-001.recommended_ux_pattern: Either persist FIELD-006 to users.phone/businesses.phone or remove required visual cue until backend persistence is added.
P5-GAP-001.later_validation_phase: PHASE 6 — ROLES, PERMISSIONS, VALIDATION & STATE CONTROL

P5-GAP-002.current_ui_behavior: Wholesale tier price field is presented in product creation/edit drawer, but backend schema and controller do not persist it to products table.
P5-GAP-002.actual_business_semantics: Wholesale customers expected to receive wholesale pricing tier during POS checkout.
P5-GAP-002.ux_problem: Pricing manager configures wholesale rate, but subsequent wholesale sales charge standard retail price.
P5-GAP-002.financial_impact: Overcharging wholesale clients or inconsistent billing
P5-GAP-002.recommended_ux_pattern: Implement physical products.wholesale_price column and persist in ProductController.
P5-GAP-002.later_validation_phase: PHASE 6 — ROLES, PERMISSIONS, VALIDATION & STATE CONTROL

P5-GAP-003.current_ui_behavior: Stock adjustment modal allows arbitrary manual entry of unit cost without showing current moving-average cost or product acquisition cost.
P5-GAP-003.actual_business_semantics: Unit cost in stock adjustment recalculates inventory valuation and affects Gross Profit.
P5-GAP-003.ux_problem: Operator has no reference cost context and can inadvertently enter erroneous valuation figures.
P5-GAP-003.financial_impact: Inventory asset valuation distortion and inaccurate cost of goods sold
P5-GAP-003.historical_integrity_impact: Improper inventory movement unit cost recording
P5-GAP-003.recommended_ux_pattern: Display current cost_price as pre-filled default and helper hint in stock adjustment form.
P5-GAP-003.later_validation_phase: PHASE 6 — ROLES, PERMISSIONS, VALIDATION & STATE CONTROL

P5-GAP-004.current_ui_behavior: Discount type selector (Percentage vs Fixed PKR) in POS checkout calculates net total in UI but backend only stores final discount value.
P5-GAP-004.actual_business_semantics: Sale receipt and reporting should indicate whether markdown was percentage or flat nominal reduction.
P5-GAP-004.ux_problem: Audit history cannot distinguish between a 10% discount and a flat 10 PKR discount if total value happens to match.
P5-GAP-004.financial_impact: None on total, minor on audit analytics
P5-GAP-004.historical_integrity_impact: Loss of discount formula intent in transaction record
P5-GAP-004.recommended_ux_pattern: Persist sales.discount_type in sales table or document flat value derivation.
P5-GAP-004.later_validation_phase: PHASE 6 — ROLES, PERMISSIONS, VALIDATION & STATE CONTROL

P5-GAP-005.current_ui_behavior: Sale return modal does not display original sale payment method or customer khata balance before operator selects refund payout method.
P5-GAP-005.actual_business_semantics: Refunding cash for a transaction that was originally charged on Khata credit causes direct cash leakage.
P5-GAP-005.ux_problem: Cashier can accidentally payout physical cash for unpaid credit sales.
P5-GAP-005.financial_impact: Cash loss / float variance from improper refund tender
P5-GAP-005.historical_integrity_impact: Unreconciled refund settlement against credit receivables
P5-GAP-005.recommended_ux_pattern: Display original sale payment mode banner and warn operator if refund method differs from original payment.
P5-GAP-005.later_validation_phase: PHASE 6 — ROLES, PERMISSIONS, VALIDATION & STATE CONTROL

P5-GAP-006.current_ui_behavior: Void sale button in sales history table triggers cancellation with generic browser confirm without itemized impact summary.
P5-GAP-006.actual_business_semantics: Voiding a sale reverses cash ledger, reverts inventory stock, and voids invoice.
P5-GAP-006.ux_problem: Operator does not see the inventory and cash ledger reversal impact prior to confirming void.
P5-GAP-006.financial_impact: Cash ledger adjustment and invoice voiding
P5-GAP-006.inventory_impact: Stock replenishment on all sold items
P5-GAP-006.historical_integrity_impact: Transaction voiding without detailed audit reason prompt
P5-GAP-006.recommended_ux_pattern: Replace generic browser confirm with dedicated Void Confirmation Modal showing restored stock counts and refunded cash amount.
P5-GAP-006.later_validation_phase: PHASE 6 — ROLES, PERMISSIONS, VALIDATION & STATE CONTROL

P5-GAP-007.current_ui_behavior: Purchase goods received note allows editing items after partial supplier payments have already been posted.
P5-GAP-007.actual_business_semantics: Editing purchase quantities or prices after partial settlement creates discrepancy in supplier payable ledger.
P5-GAP-007.ux_problem: Operator is permitted to change line items on a received GRN with active payments.
P5-GAP-007.financial_impact: Discrepancy between purchase invoice total and recorded supplier payable balance
P5-GAP-007.inventory_impact: Stock delta mismatch with physical goods received
P5-GAP-007.recommended_ux_pattern: Lock purchase line items to READ_ONLY once status transitions to RECEIVED or payments exist.
P5-GAP-007.later_validation_phase: PHASE 6 — ROLES, PERMISSIONS, VALIDATION & STATE CONTROL

P5-GAP-008.current_ui_behavior: Expense creation form defaults payment account selection to null or first account without displaying current available cash balance.
P5-GAP-008.actual_business_semantics: Posting an expense without balance check can cause cash drawer to go into negative balance.
P5-GAP-008.ux_problem: Operator posts petty cash expense without knowing if physical drawer has sufficient funds.
P5-GAP-008.recommended_ux_pattern: Display live available balance next to payment account dropdown with warning badge if amount exceeds balance.
P5-GAP-008.later_validation_phase: PHASE 6 — ROLES, PERMISSIONS, VALIDATION & STATE CONTROL

P5-GAP-009.current_ui_behavior: Customer create modal allows setting opening balance, but customer edit modal hides opening balance field and prevents correcting data entry mistakes.
P5-GAP-009.actual_business_semantics: Opening balance establishes starting ledger position; if entered mistakenly during creation, operator cannot fix it in edit modal.
P5-GAP-009.ux_problem: Hiding opening balance on customer edit intentionally protects opening historical ledger position from accidental overwrites during routine profile updates (phone, address).
P5-GAP-009.financial_impact: Uncorrected starting debt on customer statement
P5-GAP-009.recommended_ux_pattern: Maintain current pattern: opening balance remains immutable on edit, with specialized adjustment journals for ledger corrections.
P5-GAP-009.later_validation_phase: PHASE 6 — ROLES, PERMISSIONS, VALIDATION & STATE CONTROL

P5-GAP-010.current_ui_behavior: ProductInvoiceView.vue and reports1View.vue exist in Frontend/src/views codebase but are unreachable from primary navigation and duplicate active views.
P5-GAP-010.actual_business_semantics: Active functionality is served by PosSaleView.vue, SalesView.vue, and ReportsView.vue.
P5-GAP-010.ux_problem: Unrouted legacy components cause maintenance confusion and potential developer regressions.
P5-GAP-010.recommended_ux_pattern: Deprecate and archive legacy views during Phase 9 remediation.
P5-GAP-010.later_validation_phase: PHASE 6 — ROLES, PERMISSIONS, VALIDATION & STATE CONTROL
